req.title: Basic-auth handles special characters
req.statement: The system shall URL-decode <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing against the supplied Basic credentials.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should URL-decode the <user> and <passwd> path segments before comparing them against the supplied Basic credentials. This ensures that special characters in the credentials are correctly handled. The test suite includes a positive case to verify correct handling, a negative case to ensure incorrect credentials are rejected, and a boundary case to test the handling of edge cases in URL-decoding.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_positive
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word with correct Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
credentials = b64encode(b'user@example.com:pass@word').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': 'user@example.com'}

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_negative
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word with incorrect Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
credentials = b64encode(b'user@example.com:wrongpass').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
response = client.get('/basic-auth/user%40example.com/pass%40word', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 401

tests.name: test_basic_auth_special_characters_boundary
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /basic-auth/%40/%40 with correct Basic Auth credentials.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
from base64 import b64encode
client = app.test_client()
credentials = b64encode(b'@:@').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
response = client.get('/basic-auth/%40/%40', headers=headers)
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json == {'authenticated': True, 'user': '@'}
